text:
Dear Ada,
The boats came in before noon and the harbour smelled of tar and rain.
Father says the new pier will be finished by spring.
Yours, Tom

Dear Tom,
The school has a stove at last, and we read by it after lessons.
Send word when the pier is done.
Ada

To the harbour master,
The east light was dark on the night of the ninth.
Two fishing crews waited offshore until dawn.
R. Hale
